Conclusion
Diet and Nutrition are an important part of the treatment of the cancer patient. Providing patients with timely, effective nutrition
advice and interventions may help overcome the effect of nutrition related impact symptoms and support patients in tolerating
treatment and living with and beyond their diagnosis.
